item.title: Imouto to Osananajimi no Seido Shidou ~Kore Ijou Naka ni Dasu no wa Yamete!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gray Zone
  • 発売日: 2010-07-09
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹と幼馴染みの性奴指導 ～これ以上中に出すのはやめて！～
  • 英語名: Imouto to Osananajimi no Seido Shidou Kore Ijou Naka ni Dasu no wa Yamete!

あらすじ

Our protagonist is fed up with his father, who keeps getting fired from his jobs due to his heavy drinking.

Since his parents’ divorce, he has struggled, which has led to him becoming cynical and being an outsider in his class.
